name: Surrounding Path Contribution (WKB Expansion)
definition: A boundary condition of particular interest is single-sided: the path starts at a specific point (eye position) with a specific direction (viewing ray), but has no restrictions on the second end, terminating at an object or light source.
summary: Surrounding Path Contribution approximates path integrals by integrating only over the neighborhood of the Most Probable Path, exploiting its global minimum to approximate the integrand as a Gaussian distribution.
